name: apple-mail
title: Apple Mail clone
description: Apple Mail: Favorites, Smart Mailboxes and iCloud sections with rolling unread counts; a message list with unread dots, flags, attachments, previews and relative times; swipe actions (ListRow), edit mode, search and an unread filter; a message view with a quoted thread and reply, flag, move, archive and trash; and a compose sheet. One SplitView at every size: three tiled columns on desktop, an overlay sidebar on iPad, a stack with large titles and back buttons on iPhone. Composed from SplitView (sections, large titles), ListRow, Icon, SearchField, SheetContent, MarkdownEditor and DropdownMenu.
